product.eventDescription: One entry of a Best Sellers or New Releases chart (row keys rank, asin, title, url, chart, category, page, price, currency, rating, ratings_count, image, domain): $4 per 1,000 entries. A chart page is 50 ranks, so one category's Top 100 (pages 2, the default) is 100 rows, $0.40. Price is null where the chart prints none; an entry whose tile Amazon withholds still comes with rank, ASIN and URL. Not charged: entries removed by minRating or maxResultsPerCategory, an ASIN already delivered from another category, categories that return nothing, failed categories, status rows. No start fee; proxy and compute are included in the event price. The run stops at the maximum cost per run you set when starting it (Apify run option maxTotalChargeUsd).
